extraction.notes: Company reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO subtotal, so affo fields are null. Core adjustments include a 'Redemption of preferred shares' line that is zero (—) in Q2 2025. 'Other miscellaneous items (2)' is footnoted as (gain) loss on investments and one-time professional fees; categorized as 'other' because it mixes two items. Interest rate swap amortization categorized as debt_cost_amortization. FFO subtotal shown is before Series D preferred dividends (24,537); the diluted FFO of 24,697 is used for per-share checks. Check: 24,697/19,870 = $1.24 and 25,457/19,870 = $1.28, matching reported per-share figures. Recurring capex: company discloses only a per-apartment-home same-store figure ($370, S-15), not a company-total quarterly dollar amount, and it is not part of any AFFO; left null.
